messages:
Aisha Patel: Draft one-pager for Enterprise launch — target: security-conscious buyers (finance, healthcare). Focus on three pillars: Security & compliance, SLA & reliability, Deployment flexibility (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Attached doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/enterp-onepager-v1. Need: short bullets, customer outcomes, one-line CTA. Thoughts?

Marco Ruiz: Love the structure. Quick asks: include inbound lead routing notes (self-serve vs sales-assisted), a short contracting timeline, and a single benchmark callout (p99 latency + TCO improvement). Also add a qualification checkbox on the sign-up form: "deployment preference".

Jamie Lin: I can do two hero variants — one with icons (shield / clock / cloud stack) and one simplified. Will mock in Figma and link. Need final headline and 3 sub-bullets per pillar.

Priya Nair: A few legal/security flags: don't use absolutes like "unlimited SLA". Use "SLA-backed uptime" and include standard exceptions (force majeure, scheduled maintenance). For compliance: say "supports customer-managed KMS and audit logs" rather than asserting certifications (e.g., FedRAMP/HIPAA) unless we've validated them.

MarketingBot: Drive doc shared: https://drive.redwood.ai/enterp-onepager-v1 (permissions: marketing + sales). Recent benchmark deck: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/2024-q4.

Evan Brooks: For benchmark narrative — highlight a real workload: high-throughput embeddings + reranking. Callout: "~30% cost reduction at 95th-percentile throughput with Dedicated + quantization profiles (verified in Redwood lab)." Add a small visual: cost per 1M tokens vs self-host baseline. Also propose a webinar to support launch — target Nov 14. I'll own the slide deck and promo.

Aisha Patel: Great. Action items: @Marco — draft lead-routing rules and form fields; @Priya — review SLA & compliance phrasing; @Jamie — two hero variants; @Evan — benchmark blurbs + webinar plan. I'll update the one-pager with 1-line CTA and customer outcomes by EOD.

Marco Ruiz: Draft routing rules (initial): If org_size > 250 OR security_need = "high" => route to AE (sales-assisted). Else if trial_usage > X tokens or custom compliance requested => route to Solutions Eng. Lead form fields to add: [deployment_preference, compliance_needs, estimated_token_volume]. Example JSON for lead form: `{"deployment_preference":"Hosted|Dedicated|Private","compliance_needs":"HIPAA|SOC2|Other"}`

Priya Nair: Acknowledged. I'll add a compliance checklist paragraph to the doc: encryption at rest, KMS options, VPC & private control plane, audit logs, certs we support. Will avoid certification claims unless validated.

Jamie Lin: :thumbsup: will upload Figma mocks by tomorrow noon. Two sizes: website hero and PDF one-pager hero.

Evan Brooks: Webinar plan: Nov 14, 30-min (20-min product + 10-min QA). Dry run Nov 12. Promo channels: blog post, targeted emails to existing free users, partner co-promos. Need speaker list and 5 slide highlights from product.

Aisha Patel: Perfect. Final constraints reminder: keep one-pager to one page, max 5 bullets per pillar, include a benchmark callout and an explicit CTA ("Request enterprise trial" / contact link). We'll finalize Thu 11AM.
